 Advertisement Explore Betting on GOAL Getty Images 57 minutes ago Last updated 17 Nov 2026, 14:20 Translated by Nations League LIVE: Denmark face Norway and Wales host Portugal, with Bosnia also in action
 Share Follow GOAL on Google The sixth-round fixtures are under way, the last before domestic leagues resume.
 Advertisement The final matches of the sixth round of the Nations League kick off this evening at 8.45pm. They will settle the quarter-final line-up, the play-off ties and the matches to avoid relegation, as well as confirming which teams go down outright.
 In League A Group 3, already-qualified Portugal travel to Cardiff to face Wales . AC Milan striker Goncalo Ramos starts despite failing to score in his recent matches for Portugal and AC Milan. Copenhagen hosts a crucial showdown as Denmark , featuring Napoli striker Hojlund, face Haaland's Norway . The visitors need three points to reach the play-offs and keep their quarter-final hopes alive. Two of the three possible results would suit the hosts. The Napoli player puts Denmark ahead after a glaring error by Bologna's Heggem, before Hojbjerg doubles their lead from an Isaksen assist.
 Top spot in Group 2 of League B is at stake when Northern Ireland face Hungary in Budapest. The Northern Irish lead by one point, 11 to 10. Ukraine and Georgia also meet with relegation at stake.
 In League B Group 3 , Austria have already been promoted and face Israel , who are competing with Ireland and Kosovo for the promotion, play-off and relegation places. Ireland and Kosovo meet in Dublin with five and six points respectively.
 Advertisement Advertisement In Group 4 of League B , Sweden have already been promoted, as have Bosnia . Juventus player Kerim Alajbegovic starts for Bosnia at home to Romania , who are battling with Poland to stay up and avoid relegation to League C. Poland, featuring Inter's Piotr Zielinski , host the Scandinavians.
